core_from_git.description: When shared ontology on git main gains topics/aliases, notify in bot chat and let the owner agree or tweak before using them locally

candidates_from_messages.description: When gap watch finds new topic candidates from messages, notify in bot chat with a custom vs core-candidate recommendation; wait for agree/tweak. An older default_layer value of personal means custom.

ontology_gap.meaning: Before assessing gaps, compare ontology/LAST_UPDATE on git main (avilesg/message-dashboard-kit) and refresh the ontology folder if newer. Then notify in bot chat with two labeled sections: 'Core (from git)' new shared topics/aliases, and 'Candidate (from messages)' new topics spotted in messages (default custom layer; a core candidate may get a git PR). Core is the shared list everyone who builds from the recipe starts with. Custom is the user's own add-on layer and only they get it. Topics in either layer tag messages right away. Owner replies agree or suggests a tweak; nothing is applied until they agree.
ontology_gap.delivery: Bot chat; agree/tweak reply required before applying (per ontology_review)
